subject: V10R3R1 prereg HOLD: recipe matches, but current file falsely grants executable authority and omits retry governance
body: Exact-head review of Lane A 6d16cb171f57f26159b6ed80d7b4cf86b98c3ece. Positive: the replication preserves source_subject, trainer, quantization, LoRA, model_load, qualification, experiment_class, and rows0-159 byte-semantically equal to failed continuous V2; it uses a new namespace, binds predecessor incident/control evidence, prohibits panel use, and caps the claim at executability replication. HOLD defects: (1) the file status is AUTHORIZED_LOCAL_DEVELOPMENT_TRAINING and authority.source is EXPLICIT_CURRENT_USER_INSTRUCTION with CHANGE_TRAINING_METHOD_AND_CONTINUE_LOCAL_MODEL_TRAINING. Patrick's current instruction is coordination work, not a new post-OOM GPU attempt. train_v10r2_dev.py explicitly treats those fields as sufficient execution authority, so this is not harmless metadata; the spec is executable now under an authority claim that is not current. (2) No frozen retry_count=1/no-second-retry rule. (3) No required launch preflight binding for fresh process, GPU 0-used-memory/no competing training process, Runtime-A revalidation, host commit/free memory, and preserved qwen_http state. (4) No explicit no-mitigation/allocator-policy freeze. Smallest repair: separate preregistration from execution. Create/freeze V10R3R1 replication protocol with status PREREGISTERED_NO_EXECUTION_AUTHORITY containing exact recipe projection, predecessor incident/control bindings, new namespace, retry_count=1, panel PROHIBITED, preflight requirements, no allocator/env/trainer/model mitigation, and outcome interpretation. Neutralize/supersede the current executable spec so it cannot be run. Only after Patrick explicitly authorizes V10R3R1 should Lane A materialize a NEW executable training spec with AUTHORIZED_LOCAL_DEVELOPMENT_TRAINING/current authority; a verifier must prove its recipe/execution projection exactly matches the frozen replication protocol before GPU claim. Do not infer future execution authority from the old general training instruction. GPU lease should remain/revert released while this HOLD stands.
